desc:
🧪 RAGDOLL FACTORY 🧪
The lab where dummies go to get wrecked.

Grab them. Bat them. Blow them up. Then watch it again in slow motion.

💥 40+ WAYS TO CAUSE CHAOS
Bombs, saws, mines, springs, rockets, a railgun, a flamethrower and a Nova Beam you charge up and let rip.

⚡ ANIME POWERS
Fist Rush, Black Hole, Star Bomb, Meteor Rain, Zero-G, Judgement. Hold, aim, release.

🌋 SPECIAL ABILITIES
Tornado, Volcano, Tsunami, UFO, Sky Laser, Giga Hammer, Fire Tsunami and Reality Break.

🧍 PICK YOUR VICTIM
Dummies, penguins, ninjas, cats, even your own avatar. Make them rubber, glass, metal... or TNT.

🪙 EVERY KNOCK-OUT PAYS
Earn coins, unlock new powers and grab free rewards just for playing.

⏱ Slow-mo, 2x speed, heal, undo and reset whenever you want.
📱 Works on phone and PC.

🎁 Join the group for 500 free coins.
👍 Like and favourite if you want more powers!
